author_note: Read only the 13 workflow contracts in workflows/*.yaml and scripts/workflow_registry.py of the netzoo-core-p0-run worktree; nothing else was opened and the assistant was not run. Each gold was decided from the quoted contract text: do items stay inside every stated input, sample/feature, and control limit (several sit exactly on an allowed boundary, e.g. DRAGON lambdas 0 and 1, SAMBAR kmax equal to the sample count, BONOBO delta 0.3 < 1/3 with sparsify, LIONESS-DRAGON value count computed from features x samples below 20,000,000); dont items break exactly one quoted condition (min_samples, features>samples, the 20,000,000-value cap, both-lambdas rule, delta < 1/3 with sparsify, no GIRAFFE controls, aggregate-only OTTER, two-layer-only DRAGON, incompatible input artifacts, CONDOR not taking raw expression, association not causation); ask items carry the user's own stated uncertainty or conflict about the single fact that a quoted condition turns on; vague items name no concrete result but stay within what registered workflows produce. Feature-pair counts for LIONESS-DRAGON use n(n-1)/2 over both layers' features, with margins wide enough that including the diagonal does not change any verdict.
